meta.description: Single source of truth for LLM agent onboarding. Read this first before any code changes.
meta.update_policy: Regenerate on every PR merge. CI agent auto-syncs.

identity.name: ultrameshai
identity.tagline: Loop-engineering agent stack — SWE-bench Verified ≥98%, then Rust/Zig mesh app on cloud VMs + Raspberry Pis

ultrameshai.purpose: Core monorepo: Rust crates (transport, cognition, orchestrator), agent harness (Nushell), protobuf contracts, kompress-ultra submodule

kompress-ultra.purpose: 4-role context compression middleware (scorer, rewriter, pruner, circulator). Standalone npm package + OpenCode plugin.

proposal.vaked.dev.purpose: SOTA proposal site — interactive math, benchmark viz, cryptographic reviews, i18n (6 languages). Cloudflare Pages.

pocoo.vaked.dev.purpose: Experiment log vault — static site generated from markdown posts. Cloudflare Pages.

portail.purpose: Rust HTTP gateway/proxy (axum). Routes: AI proxy, MCP, A2A, CDN. Serves on :8787.

second-brain-cloudflare.purpose: Cloudflare Workers MCP server — semantic memory (D1 + Vectorize). Tools: remember, recall, forget.

layers.name: Cognition
layers.description: LLM client, session management, prompt assembly, tool dispatch

layers.name: Orchestration
layers.description: Topology mapping, loop routing, slice assignment

layers.name: Transport
layers.description: Framed protobuf over UDS, node registry, heartbeat

layers.name: Execution
layers.description: Target node daemon, Bun runtimes, agent unit sandboxing

layers.name: Memory
layers.description: Long-term storage: Milvus vectors, SQLite mempalace, context circulator

architecture.ipc_contract: proto/loop_engineering.proto — 11 message types, 1 enum, max 4MB framed

key_files.AGENTS.md: Agent onboarding doc — architecture, commands, layout, constraints
key_files.mesh.nu: Nushell dev harness — status/serve/test/build/deploy across repos
key_files.proto/loop_engineering.proto: Single typed IPC contract across all components
key_files.second-brain-cloudflare/: MCP memory server on Cloudflare Workers

frameworks.tokio: Async runtime for all Rust crates

commands.kompress_build: cd packages/kompress-ultra && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist

constraints.hardware: Cloud VMs (64GB RAM) + Raspberry Pi (4GB RAM) — test on both
constraints.macos_limitation: Cannot run nix flake check or nix develop — verify on target Linux nodes
constraints.tdd: Required for all Rust crates (failing test first, then implementation)
constraints.caveman_mode: Active in this project. Code/commits/PRs stay normal English.

ultrameshai.conflict_note: Remote has kompress-ultra as regular files, local has submodule. Needs fresh branch or force push.
